commands: echo '== Adjusting PHP, PHP-FPM and Apache upload limits to 1 GiB =='
if grep -q -E '^\s*upload_max_filesize\s*=' $PHP_INI; then sed -i -E 's/^(\s*upload_max_filesize\s*=\s*).*/\11024M/' $PHP_INI; else echo 'upload_max_filesize = 1024M' >> $PHP_INI; fi
if grep -q -E '^\s*post_max_size\s*=' $PHP_INI; then sed -i -E 's/^(\s*post_max_size\s*=\s*).*/\11024M/' $PHP_INI; else echo 'post_max_size = 1024M' >> $PHP_INI; fi
# Raise memory_limit for large SCORM processing
if grep -q -E '^\s*memory_limit\s*=' $PHP_INI; then sed -i -E 's/^(\s*memory_limit\s*=\s*).*/\14096M/' $PHP_INI; else echo 'memory_limit = 4096M' >> $PHP_INI; fi
# Increase input/execution time to accommodate slow large uploads
if grep -q -E '^\s*max_input_time\s*=' $PHP_INI; then sed -i -E 's/^(\s*max_input_time\s*=\s*).*/\1900/' $PHP_INI; else echo 'max_input_time = 900' >> $PHP_INI; fi
if grep -q -E '^\s*max_execution_time\s*=' $PHP_INI; then sed -i -E 's/^(\s*max_execution_time\s*=\s*).*/\1600/' $PHP_INI; else echo 'max_execution_time = 600' >> $PHP_INI; fi
# Apache vhost: increase timeouts; explicitly allow large bodies

if ! grep -q -E '^\s*LimitRequestBody\b' $VHOST_CONF; then awk 'BEGIN{ins=0;v=0} /<VirtualHost/{v=1} /<\/VirtualHost>/{v=0} {print; if (v && !ins && /DirectoryIndex/) { print "  LimitRequestBody 0"; ins=1 } }' $VHOST_CONF > ${VHOST_CONF}.tmp && mv ${VHOST_CONF}.tmp $VHOST_CONF || true; fi
# Moodle site-level max upload size (1 GiB)
if [ -f /app/moodle/admin/cli/cfg.php ]; then sudo -u apache php /app/moodle/admin/cli/cfg.php --name=maxbytes --set=1073741824 || true; fi

if [ -f /app/moodle/config.php ]; then DBHOST=$(awk -F"'" '/\$CFG->dbhost/{print $2}' /app/moodle/config.php); DBNAME=$(awk -F"'" '/\$CFG->dbname/{print $2}' /app/moodle/config.php); DBUSER=$(awk -F"'" '/\$CFG->dbuser/{print $2}' /app/moodle/config.php); DBPASS=$(awk -F"'" '/\$CFG->dbpass/{print $2}' /app/moodle/config.php); echo -n 'maxbytes in DB: '; mariadb -h "$DBHOST" -u "$DBUSER" -p"$DBPASS" -D "$DBNAME" -N -B -e "SELECT value FROM mdl_config WHERE name='maxbytes';" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
